item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong on Saturday morning. It will become cold appreciably over the region. The associated intense winter monsoon will bring persistently cold weather during the weekend to midweek next week. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China from Saturday to next Monday.

Date/Month: 17/02 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 5 to 6, occasionally force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 16 - 18 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
